uncited: **Density Volume:** A 3D array (texture) of single-precision floating-point numbers.
Dimensions correspond to the voxel grid resolution.
It calculates a linear fit slope and offset, determines a sample size capped at the dataset length, and optionally uses stratified sampling to select indices.
*   **Time Complexity:** The density calculation for each voxel requires querying neighbors within radius $r$.
The density volume requires $O(V)$ space, where $V$ is the number of voxels.
Reduces high-frequency noise present in point-based rendering.
*   **Limitations:** Lacks the ability to track changes in the point cloud over time in a single rendering; sequential volume renderings are required to observe evolution.
